hero.heading: Built around business.
hero.lead: Established in 2022, Mera Software helps local businesses build their online presence, connect with customers and improve operations through digital solutions.
hero.description: We bring business understanding, creative design and technical development into one coordinated service.

purpose.heading: Making digital decisions clearer.
paragraphs: Mera Software began when Jasmeet Kaur saw the challenges businesses faced in moving online—from unclear advice to poorly managed services.
That experience shaped our purpose: to give business owners informed guidance, relevant solutions and clear responsibility for the work.

approach.heading: Your business determines
paragraphs: We understand your services, customers and priorities before recommending platforms or technology.
From business profiles and websites to mobile apps, CRM and marketing, our work follows a plan suited to your needs. We coordinate the content, design and development required to deliver it.
